content.heading: Why Curated WhatsApp Communities Matter
content.body: WhatsApp groups have evolved into one of the fastest ways to network, discover local communities, learn new skills, and connect with like-minded people around the world. However, clicking random invite links on unmoderated forums can expose your phone number to spam bots and low-quality broadcasts. Using a curated directory like LinkHub helps you filter communities by topic and quality before joining.

whatsappCta.title: Explore Verified Tech & Career Communities
whatsappCta.description: Join moderated developer, business, and networking WhatsApp groups safely.

content.heading: 1. Lock Down Your WhatsApp Privacy Settings First
content.body: Before joining any public group, open WhatsApp Settings > Privacy. Set your Profile Photo, About, and Status visibility to 'My Contacts' instead of 'Everyone'. Also, change 'Groups' privacy to 'My Contacts' so strangers inside public groups cannot automatically add you to other unwanted chats without your permission.

content.heading: 2. Evaluate the Group Description and Admins
content.body: Healthy WhatsApp groups always have clear rules in the group description, active admins, and a focused topic—whether that is tech jobs, study resources, gaming, or local events. If a group immediately asks for sensitive personal data, verification codes, or upfront payments, leave and report the group right away.

whatsappCta.title: Looking for Active Community Chats?
whatsappCta.description: Connect with friendly members in verified social, entertainment, and hobby groups.

content.heading: 3. Respect Group Etiquette to Avoid Bans
content.body: Avoid sending bulk forwarded messages, unsolicited promotional links, or repetitive messages right after joining. WhatsApp's automated anti-spam systems can restrict accounts that get reported by multiple group members in a short window. Introduce yourself politely when appropriate and contribute to ongoing discussions.

content.heading: 4. Use LinkHub Categories to Find Your Niche
content.body: Instead of joining dozens of random groups at once, pick two or three high-engagement communities in categories you genuinely care about. Mute notifications for high-volume groups so you can catch up on your own schedule while keeping your chat list organized.
